title: WHO Launches New Cancer Drug Plan for Children
titleZh: 世卫组织启动儿童抗癌新药计划
credits: Robin Millard reported on this story for Agence France-Presse. John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) has launched a new service, or platform, to provide free cancer medicines to thousands of children in less wealthy nations.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）推出了一项新服务或平台，为低收入国家数千名儿童提供免费抗癌药物。

sentences.en: The WHO defines these as low- and middle-income countries.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织将这类国家定义为中低收入国家。

sentences.en: The first medicines were to be provided to Mongolia and Uzbekistan.
sentences.zh: 首批药物将提供给蒙古和乌兹别克斯坦。

sentences.en: The next shipments would go to Ecuador, Jordan, Nepal and Zambia, as part of the project's testing, or pilot period, the WHO said.
sentences.zh: 世卫组织表示，下一批药物将运往厄瓜多尔、约旦、尼泊尔和赞比亚，作为该项目的试验或试点阶段。

sentences.en: The drug treatments are expected to reach around 5,000 children with cancer this year across at least 30 hospitals in the six countries.
sentences.zh: 预计今年这些药物治疗将在六个国家的至少30家医院为约5000名儿童癌症患者提供帮助。

sentences.en: "Countries in the pilot phase will receive an uninterrupted supply of quality-assured childhood cancer medicines at no cost," the U.N. health agency said in a statement.
sentences.zh: 世卫组织在一份声明中表示："试点阶段的国家将获得无成本、质量有保障的持续儿童癌症药物供应。"

sentences.en: The WHO said childhood cancer survival rates in low- and middle-income countries were often below 30 percent.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织表示，中低收入国家的儿童癌症存活率通常低于30%。

sentences.en: That compares to survival rates of around 80 percent in wealthy nations.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，富裕国家的存活率约为80%。

sentences.en: The agency’s Director-General, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, said in a statement, "For too long, children with cancer have lacked access to life-saving medicines."
sentences.zh: 该机构总干事谭德塞·阿达姆·格布雷耶苏斯在一份声明中表示："长期以来，癌症儿童缺乏获得救命药物的途径。"

sentences.en: He added that the new platform aims to bring "health and hope to children around the world."
sentences.zh: 他补充说，新平台旨在为"世界各地的儿童带来健康和希望。"

sentences.en: El Salvador, Moldova, Senegal, Ghana, Pakistan and Sri Lanka are expected to join the program very soon.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多、摩尔多瓦、塞内加尔、加纳、巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡预计将很快加入该项目。

sentences.en: The platform hopes to reach 50 countries in the next five to seven years, providing medicines for up to 120,000 children.
sentences.zh: 该平台希望在未来五到七年内覆盖50个国家，为多达12万名儿童提供药物。

sentences.en: The WHO estimates about 400,000 children worldwide develop cancer every year.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织估计，全球每年约有40万名儿童患癌。

sentences.en: Most of the children live in places with limited resources.
sentences.zh: 大多数儿童生活在资源有限的地区。

sentences.en: The agency says about 70 percent of children in those settings die for several reasons.
sentences.zh: 该机构表示，在这些地区约有70%的儿童因多种原因死亡。

sentences.en: These include the use of low-quality medicines, an inability to get correct treatments, or problems with the supply of treatments.
sentences.zh: 这些原因包括使用低质量药物、无法获得正确治疗，或治疗供应出现问题。

sentences.en: The plan to establish the platform was first announced in December 2021.
sentences.zh: 建立该平台的计划于2021年12月首次宣布。

sentences.en: It is a cooperative deal between the WHO and St. Jude Children's Research Hospital in Memphis, Tennessee in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是世界卫生组织与美国田纳西州孟菲斯市圣犹达儿童研究医院之间的一项合作协议。

sentences.en: The U.S. non-profit treatment and research organization provided $200 million for its launch, the WHO said.
sentences.zh: 世卫组织表示，这家美国非营利治疗和科研机构为其启动提供了2亿美元。

sentences.en: The WHO called the financial commitment the largest ever made for childhood cancer medicines worldwide.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织称，这一资金支持是迄今为止为全球儿童癌症药物提供的最大规模承诺。

sentences.en: It added that the cost-free service would continue beyond the pilot phase.
sentences.zh: 它补充说，这项免费服务将在试点阶段之后继续开展。

sentences.en: The platform is working on developing its sustainability – or ability to continue to provide the service - over the longer term.
sentences.zh: 该平台正在努力提升其可持续性——即长期持续提供服务的能力。

sentences.en: Andre Ilbawi is with the WHO's cancer control program.
sentences.zh: 安德烈·伊勒巴维是世界卫生组织癌症防控项目的工作人员。

sentences.en: He told reporters the program seeks to widen the platform and bring additional partners on board.
sentences.zh: 他告诉记者，该项目旨在扩大平台规模，吸引更多合作伙伴加入。

sentences.en: "This marks the beginning of a global movement to provide children with cancer the medicines that they need, regardless of where they live, or their ability to pay," Ilbawi said.
sentences.zh: 伊勒巴维说：'这标志着一场全球运动的开端，将为癌症患儿提供他们所需的药物，无论他们身处何地，也无论他们是否有能力支付。'

sentences.en: He added that the issue of children with cancer was getting more attention in wealthier countries.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，儿童癌症问题在较富裕国家正受到更多关注。

sentences.en: "Childhood cancer is increasingly a leading cause of death for middle- and high-income countries…so governments are increasingly paying attention," Ilbawi said.
sentences.zh: 伊勒巴维说：'儿童癌症正日益成为中低收入和高收入国家的主要死因……因此各国政府正日益予以关注。'

sentences.en: I’m John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·拉塞尔。
